rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for an ink design on the skin.

example.english: They have a beautiful tattoo on their arm.
example.traditional: 佢隻手臂有個好靚嘅紋身。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zek3 sau2 bei3 jau5 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 man4 san1

rows.note: Use this as a less colloquial alternative, especially in written or tattoo-related contexts.

example.english: This tattoo artwork was completed using traditional hand-poked techniques.
example.traditional: 呢幅刺青作品係用傳統針法完成嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 ci3 ceng1 zok3 ban2 hai6 jung6 cyun4 tung2 zam1 faat3 jyun4 sing4 ge3
